book.name: Irina rae Fureniro
book.title: Irina rae Fureniro Iesuꞌa Irina rae Fureniroteꞌe Ḡoeꞌa

content: Roḡae Daro Fuꞌa zu Butu Agireḡa

Badiꞌa zama ḡugi iriꞌavoniroteꞌe siuvaḡa fuꞌo aheu fare meiroteꞌe tuḡureḡa viga fuꞌo aheu fare boꞌaḡano ꞌahoganiꞌa eḡe vaḡe aradu ꞌahige rae reiro, “Aroꞌi, eḡeꞌa vu boro ḡehaḡa genaḡano ne boro bagaḡaniꞌa aduga hiditeꞌe moneo ihoꞌiꞌuma. Ne boro aꞌe roḡae daro fuꞌa bagaḡa heuḡa.
Raha kiniḡakiniḡaniꞌa roḡae eꞌe teite daroe futaro ebu rahao radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa ane vaini vuḡa gagadu ane daro fuꞌa haḡaiḡa hegotiro.”

Ebu Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa eḡe rana reirotene, eḡe tutuhe haba bohaꞌa onamiro. Eꞌea roḡae ꞌahoganiꞌa butu agireḡa kanaḡa rana ehoreꞌeteꞌe horoniro. Butu agireḡa ahiꞌa ranaꞌe Badiꞌa ni rae sausauneꞌeteꞌe niḡaniḡa mirihoganiꞌa iriꞌaviro. Ebu vadiga niduꞌaꞌe fuꞌo aheu fare zu araḡa niduꞌaꞌe gaubanana.

Roḡae aꞌe dabua peporoḡa zu kanaḡa vidaro, ebu golo zu naeḡa boro hadiḡa nunu ebu gudugudu naeḡa boro hina rohorohoniro. Ani ꞌevoꞌano golo bioḡa oboniro. Bio zamaḡanoꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa heꞌeheꞌeneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa zu ane daro fuꞌa toraganiꞌa iriꞌaviro.
Zehereḡanoꞌe ni ꞌahoga mirihoga eꞌe. Ni eꞌe hugaꞌe ꞌuꞌuruḡa. Aꞌe ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Ne Boro Bagaḡa Babulonia, Daro Fuꞌa Roḡaeḡaroḡaeḡa Vize, Rahao Badiꞌaꞌa Heꞌeheꞌeneꞌeteꞌe Ḡauḡa Niduꞌa Vize.”
E roḡae aꞌe gagone fuꞌa horoniro. Aniꞌa Badiꞌa mone azaḡa ruze ufeta gagiro. Zeꞌe Iesu moneo rae fureniroteꞌe azaḡa. E roḡae eꞌe horonadu zaguzagau rudaro.

Rehano tuḡure viganiꞌa ꞌahige ihiro, “Ḡa nougadu zaguzagauꞌohe? Eḡeꞌa roḡae eꞌe moneo ꞌuꞌuru touga ihoꞌiꞌuma. Ebu aniꞌa ehoreꞌeteꞌe butu agireḡa moneo ꞌuꞌuru touga ihoꞌiꞌuma. Butu agireḡa vadigaꞌe fuꞌo aheu fare zu araḡaꞌe gaubanana.
Ḡaeꞌa horoniroteꞌe butu agireḡaꞌe ibite radiro, rehano izidiꞌe oꞌoꞌa. Aniꞌa vesuꞌu idu vo huneonoꞌo

bua eradu Badiꞌaꞌa ani ruine hauḡiꞌuma. Rahao radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano nuꞌa ani horonadu zaguzagaꞌuma. Zeꞌe raha zu adure haḡairoteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo iniu ḡaboziteꞌe azaḡa nize mirihiroteꞌe bukaḡano nize oꞌoꞌa azaḡa. Butu agireḡa aꞌe ibite radiro, rehano izidi oꞌoꞌa, ebu vesuꞌu ariteꞌe uꞌano, ze ani horonadu zaguzagaꞌuma.
Zamarone huhuzaḡa hina faine zamare huniꞌuma. Butu agireḡa vadiga fuꞌo aheu fareꞌe roḡae eꞌeꞌa ehoreꞌeteꞌe maḡaḡa fuꞌo aheu fareo idaniro.
Zuni maḡamaḡa aꞌe kini fuꞌo aheu fareo idaniro. Kini fuꞌoꞌe rudaro, rehano ꞌahogaꞌe radiuꞌohe. Ebu ꞌahogaꞌe ꞌize mene areha, rehano aniꞌa arine mada tahiḡa daꞌo radiꞌuma.
Ibite radiro rehano, izidi mene radiuꞌeteꞌe butu agireḡaꞌe kini fuꞌo uḡidu fareḡa rae reꞌuma. Aniꞌe ibite kini fuꞌo aheu fare boꞌaḡano ꞌahoga, ebu Badiꞌaꞌa ruine huniꞌuma.
Ḡaeꞌa horoniroteꞌe araḡa gaubananaꞌe kini gaubananao idaniro. Ze ꞌize raha azaḡa zuhiꞌaziteꞌe mene ḡadahiro, rehano butu agireḡa eꞌe teite zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe kiniḡa inaraḡa mada tahiḡa daꞌo meꞌuma.
Ze zamaze tibano inaraze zu gigiꞌaze butu agireḡa haꞌuma.

Ze zu butu agireḡaꞌe Mamoe Ubuga utitohaꞌuma, rehano Mamoe Ubuganiꞌa zeḡe niduꞌa raharahaziꞌuma. Mazaḡa aniꞌe zuhiꞌa niduꞌa vitizeꞌeteꞌe Zuhiꞌaḡa Boro zu kini niduꞌa vitizeꞌeteꞌe Kiniḡa. Mamoe Ubuga ḡatineꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Mamoe Ubuganiꞌa huziroteꞌe zu ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa. Zeꞌe zamaze niduꞌa hina ani hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.”

Ebu tuḡure viga eꞌeꞌa ꞌahige ihiro, “Ḡaeꞌa roḡae daro fuꞌa eꞌeꞌa vu boro ḡehaḡa genaḡano ehore radiroteꞌe horoniro. Vu boro aꞌe vaze nunu, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa nunu, habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡa nunu, zu ḡoere nunu azaḡano idaziro.
Ḡaꞌa horoniroteꞌe butu agireḡa zu araḡa gaubananaꞌe roḡae daro fuꞌa heꞌeheꞌeniꞌuma. Zeꞌe ani ruiniꞌuma zu firinohaꞌuma. Ze ani modare aꞌuma zu ire roga hina hufi haoniꞌuma.

Mazaḡa zeꞌa ꞌouge haḡaoga veize Badiꞌaꞌa zamarone ꞌuguḡa zamazeo tiro. Eꞌanoꞌo ze Badiꞌa ura haḡaiꞌuma, ebu ze zeḡeꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe inaraḡaꞌe butu agireḡa eꞌe haꞌuma rae ḡoere idaniꞌuma, onamo Badiꞌa ḡoereꞌa hudaꞌuma.
Ḡaeꞌa horoniroteꞌe roḡaeḡaꞌe ne boro bagaḡa eꞌe. Ne boro bagaḡa eꞌeꞌa raha kiniḡakiniḡa zuhiꞌaziꞌohe.”
